import os, subprocess, time
data = open('/workspace/dev/multiline.jsonl', 'rb').read()
proc = subprocess.Popen(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/')
proc.stdin.write(data)
proc.stdin.close()
n = 0
maxt = 0
while proc.poll() is None:
    n += 1
    try:
        with open('/proc/%d/status' % proc.pid) as fh:
            for line in fh:
                if line.startswith('Threads:'):
                    maxt = max(maxt, int(line.split()[1]))
    except Exception as e:
        print('sample error:', type(e).__name__, e)
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
print('samples', n, 'max threads', maxt, 'exit', proc.returncode)
print('lines', len(proc.stdout.read().splitlines()))
